value.author: Julissa
value.title: Quick trip
value.text:
Great beach location. The size of the 2bedroom condo very nice and big. Clean. Great food at the restaurant.
— For what you charge for 1 night at a 2bedroom condo it needs upgrading and more comfortable beds. Prices at the restaurant were also too high. Good food though.

value.author: James
value.title: excellent location, great restaurant.
value.text: No breakfast as we brought ours from home.  Turtle Club experience was phenomenal.  The lobster bisque was so delicious that we came back just for that!

value.author: Maria
value.title: Una joyita, nos sentimos como en casa!
value.text:
La ubicacion, el tamaño y la calidez del lugar
— Modernizar un poco la habitacion

value.author: Maria
value.title: Impecable , solo cambiaría algunos detalles , más moderna la cocina y baño
value.text:
La cercanía a la playa
— Deberían actualizar las habitaciones

value.author: Claudio
value.title: Hermosas vacaciones en una playa excelente
value.text:
Ubicación, limpieza, playa, servicio de playa y de habitaciones
— Habitación en planta baja poco luminosa

value.author: Alberto
value.title: استثنائي
value.text:
Muy buena atención y muy buen sistema
— Deberían dar una hora más para el checkout

value.author: Jazmin
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: Súper cómodo y limpio. Amenities necesarios para la estadía.

value.author: Sayah
value.title: Tres tres bien nous reviendrons
value.text:
L’emplacement, le restaurant face a la mer.
La qualité du service exceptionnelle sauf un des voiturier qui ne disait même pas bonjour . Un cas très isolé mais qui porte préjudice au reste.
— Un des deux voiturier … pas très concerné, pas aimable et même impoli ne disant jamais bonjour.

value.author: Solon
value.title: رائع
value.text:
Lugar muito bonito. É uma edificação histórica da praia, um marco do local, que já é uma praia espetacular, o edifício remete aos anos dourados e mantém a aura daquela época. Uma viagem no tempo com as amenidades do presente. E tem um restaurante famoso e bem frequentado anexo ao hotel e virado para a praia.
— O quarto é bom, o banheiro é gigante, só o ar condicionado que é um pouco barulhento. Seria bom se tivesse um pouco mais de snacks no café da recepção.

value.author: Julian
value.title: Pequeño hotel encantador detenido en el tiempo
value.text:
Es pequeño y eso lo hace muy cómodo
— Todo me gustó

value.author: Javier
value.title: Maravilloso
value.text:
Sobre la playa
— Todo excelente

value.author: Reynaldo
value.title: Engaño
value.text: — Me ofrecieron y pagué 1ra línea de playa y me osprdaron en el condominio del otro lado de la calle no es justo el pago gracias

value.author: Maikel
value.title: Amazing place, definitely will come back next year
value.text:
Amazing location and staff
— Last year the place was quiet, and everybody respect the quiet time. This year some people were making noise after the quiet time, even a neighbor from the 1st floor knocked in our door at the 2nd floor to claim for the noise, and it came from the third one…same at the pool, a lot of noise. The property will consider to  avoid this kind of behavior

value.author: Jasmine
value.title: جيد جداً
value.text:
Well situated, cute and small and easy to navigate.
— Except the towel people and Lauren at the front desk, most of the staff weren’t that friendly or welcoming or accommodating.

value.author: Alexei
value.title: Great experience would recommend and go back
value.text:
Location was a perfect beachfront property.
— Did not dislike anything

value.author: Yamir
value.title: It was lovely! I will be back!
value.text: Beautiful property and very convenient! Everybody was nice and it was very clean and the employees always accommodated us!

value.author: Adrián
value.title: Muy buena estadía.
value.text:
Está sobre la playa. Camas cómodas. Muy limpio. Parking gratis.
— Si tengo que valorar algo malo es la poca amabilidad del personal del restaurante. Pero no quiero generalizar.

value.author: Viviana
value.title: Las habitaciones perfectas y espaciosas la vista impresionante pero lo más lindo fue la playa
value.text: Todo hermoso lugar

value.author: Cintia
value.title: Hermoso lugar para disfrutar de unas vacaciones soñadas
value.text: La ubicación, la atención!! Está en una playa soñada

value.author: Cesar
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: Quarto amplo. Cozinha com utensílios para preparos rápidos. Banheiro com dois chuveiros para família.

value.author: Dasnay
value.title: Excelente
value.text: Todo muy limpio y acogedor

value.author: San
value.title: جيد جداً
value.text:
La ubicación la vista
— No te recibe nadie ni te lleva equipaje. No tiene desayuno

value.author: Villalobos
value.title: استثنائي
value.text:
La atención hubiccion, exclente
— El restaurante solo abre de 11am a 12.30 pm,  y de 5pm a 9pm. Tuve que salir a comprar comida a fuera

value.author: Martinez
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: Excellent

value.author: Pablofern
value.title: A great beachfront hotel with friendly staff, excellent amenities, and an ideal location.
value.text:
The location is excellent, especially if you get a unit in the beachfront section of the complex. The beach is just steps away, making it very convenient to enjoy the ocean and the beautiful views. The area felt safe, quiet, and well maintained.
— Some parts of the room need maintenance, particularly the paintwork, which showed signs of wear. The sofa bed also had broken springs and was uncomfortable to use. It should be repaired or replaced before the next guest arrives. This room was located in an annex building across the street from the main building.
